description: Highest market cap in the last 60 company rows, an upper bound on float under the baby shelf rule because affiliate holdings are assumed to be zero.

Estimated remaining baby shelf rule capacity after rough prior stock proceeds are removed.
Cash gap over 12 months based on four quarters of burn less current liquidity.
Estimated baby shelf rule room divided by the cash gap, clipped from zero to 20.
Estimated baby shelf rule room divided by current market cap.
